definitions.explanation: Describes something continuing for an extremely long time without end. Often implies tedium or exhaustion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{延々|えんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{延々|えんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{続|つづ}けた→言い続ける：29059_iitsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: He kept complaining on and on.

examples.japanese: {延々|えんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked along the seemingly endless road.

notes:
{延々|えんえん} emphasizes excessive length or duration, often with a negative connotation of tedium or exhaustion. It can describe both time (a meeting dragging on) and physical extent (a road stretching on forever).

COMMON PATTERNS:
As a taru-adjective, it takes ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ when used adverbially ({延々|えんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧) and たる when modifying a noun ({延々|えんえん}たる). The ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ form is far more common in modern usage.
- {延々|えんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue endlessly
- {延々|えんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk on and on
- {延々|えんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk on and on
- {延々|えんえん}○⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: for a full ○ hours (emphasizing length)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}に→永遠に：27243_eienni⟧: eternally (neutral or positive, often about love or ideals)
- ⟦だらだら→だらだら：05843_daradara⟧: dragging on lazily (more casual, implies lack of focus)
- ⟦いつまでも→いつまでも：01814_itsumademo⟧: forever, indefinitely (neutral)
